name: standalone-player-windows
description: Verify the combined five-tab menu is removed from player routes and Rebirth, Settings, and Missions render as exclusive compact-safe surfaces.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='PunchWall Standalone Windows 740x360' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local d={Name=n,Width=740,Height=360,PixelDensity=326,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Phone} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,d) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(d) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetOrientationAsync(Enum.ScreenOrientation.LandscapeLeft) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.35) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id,width=r.X,height=r.Y})
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local l=p:WaitForChild('leaderstats') l.WallLevel.Value=54 return H:JSONEncode({WallLevel=l.WallLevel.Value})
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local l=p.leaderstats l.Coins.Value=1000000 return H:JSONEncode({Coins=l.Coins.Value,Rebirths=l.Rebirths.Value})

steps.label: Rebirth HUD route opens standalone window

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local w=g.RebirthWindow local old=g.GameMenu local active=0 for _,n in ipairs({'RebirthWindow','SettingsWindow','GameMenu'}) do local x=g:FindFirstChild(n) if x and x.Visible then active+=1 end end local min=math.huge local bad={} for _,x in ipairs(w:GetDescendants()) do if x:IsA('GuiButton') and x.Visible then min=math.min(min,x.AbsoluteSize.X,x.AbsoluteSize.Y) elseif x:IsA('TextLabel') and x.Visible and x.Text~='' and not x.TextFits then table.insert(bad,x.Name..'='..x.Text) end end local function overlaps(a,b) if not a or not b then return true end local ap,as,bp,bs=a.AbsolutePosition,a.AbsoluteSize,b.AbsolutePosition,b.AbsoluteSize return ap.X<bp.X+bs.X and bp.X<ap.X+as.X and ap.Y<bp.Y+bs.Y and bp.Y<ap.Y+as.Y end local reward=w.Body:FindFirstChild('RewardCard') local icon=reward and reward:FindFirstChild('RewardIcon') local title=reward and reward:FindFirstChild('RewardTitle') local value=reward and reward:FindFirstChild('RewardValue') local headerIcon=w.Header:FindFirstChild('HeaderIcon') local coinRequirement=w.Body:FindFirstChild('CoinsRequirement') local coinIcon=coinRequirement and coinRequirement:FindFirstChild('RequirementIcon') local coinIconExact=coinIcon and coinIcon:GetAttribute('ThemeIcon')=='RebirthCoin' and coinIcon:GetAttribute('ThemeIconSource')=='StandaloneAsset' and coinIcon.Image=='rbxassetid://135091225093305' local rewardClear=not overlaps(icon,title) and not overlaps(icon,value) and not overlaps(title,value) local headerSafe=(w:GetAttribute('CompactHeaderSafeLeft') or 0)>=90 and headerIcon and headerIcon.AbsolutePosition.X>=90 local ok=w.Visible and active==1 and old.Tabs.Visible==false and w:GetAttribute('RebirthState')=='LOCKED' and w.Body.WallLevelRequirement and w.Body.CoinsRequirement and coinIconExact and min>=44 and #bad==0 and rewardClear and headerSafe assert(ok,'standalone Rebirth diagnostics failed '..H:JSONEncode({active=active,min=min,bad=bad,state=w:GetAttribute('RebirthState'),coinIconExact=coinIconExact,rewardClear=rewardClear,headerSafe=headerSafe})) return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,active=active,min=min,bad=#bad,state=w:GetAttribute('RebirthState'),coinIconExact=coinIconExact,rewardClear=rewardClear,headerSafe=headerSafe})

steps.label: standalone Rebirth is exclusive readable and touch safe
Settings tool route opens standalone window

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local w=g.SettingsWindow local active=0 for _,n in ipairs({'RebirthWindow','SettingsWindow','GameMenu'}) do local x=g:FindFirstChild(n) if x and x.Visible then active+=1 end end local rows={'SOUNDSetting','MOTIONSetting','UI SIZESetting'} local min=math.huge local bad=0 local exact=true for _,n in ipairs(rows) do exact=exact and w.Body:FindFirstChild(n)~=nil end for _,x in ipairs(w:GetDescendants()) do if x:IsA('GuiButton') and x.Visible then min=math.min(min,x.AbsoluteSize.X,x.AbsoluteSize.Y) elseif x:IsA('TextLabel') and x.Visible and x.Text~='' and not x.TextFits then bad+=1 end end local soundIcon=w.Body.SOUNDSetting:FindFirstChild('SettingIcon') local motionIcon=w.Body.MOTIONSetting:FindFirstChild('SettingIcon') local iconExact=soundIcon and soundIcon:GetAttribute('ThemeIcon')=='SoundTool' and soundIcon:GetAttribute('ThemeIconSource')=='StandaloneAsset' and motionIcon and motionIcon:GetAttribute('ThemeIcon')=='Punch' and motionIcon:GetAttribute('ThemeIconSource')=='Atlas' local ok=w.Visible and active==1 and g.GameMenu.Tabs.Visible==false and exact and iconExact and min>=44 and bad==0 assert(ok,'standalone Settings diagnostics failed '..H:JSONEncode({active=active,min=min,bad=bad,exact=exact,iconExact=iconExact})) return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,active=active,min=min,bad=bad,exact=exact,iconExact=iconExact})

steps.label: standalone Settings is exclusive readable and touch safe

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local s=H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.SettingsJSON.Value) assert(s.sound==false and s.motion==true and s.uiScale==1,'Settings did not persist exact state') return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,sound=s.sound,motion=s.motion,uiScale=s.uiScale})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local m=g.GameMenu local title=m.StandaloneHostTitle local oldRebirth=m.Content:FindFirstChild('HERO REBIRTH • READY') or m.Content:FindFirstChild('HERO REBIRTH • LOCKED') local ok=m.Visible and title.Visible and title.Text=='MISSIONS' and m.Tabs.Visible==false and oldRebirth==nil assert(ok,'Missions surface still exposes combined tabs/Rebirth') return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,title=title.Text,tabs=m.Tabs.Visible,rebirth=oldRebirth~=nil})

steps.label: Missions surface has no combined tabs or embedded Rebirth

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='PunchWall Standalone Windows 740x360' S:StopSimulationAsync() local removed=0 for _,id in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id) if info.Name==n and info.IsCustom then S:RemoveDeviceAsync(id) removed+=1 end end return H:JSONEncode({default=S:GetDeviceAsync()=='default',removed=removed})
